title: Social and Ethical Risks Posed by General-Purpose LLMs for Settling Newcomers in Canada

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the model for job recommendations for newcomers from various countries and comparing the qualitative differences in suggested job titles and the quantitative differences in their median salaries.

Translating prompts about vaccine requirements and banking services into multiple languages (up to 32 languages, as well as comparing Canada's official languages of English and French) and measuring the accuracy, completeness, and level of agency provided in the model's responses.

bias_targets.target: Intersectional Stereotyping (Immigration status, Ethnicity, Religion, and Gender)
bias_targets.methodology: Asking the model to generate images and text descriptions of 'refugee' and 'immigrant' families, and analyzing the outputs for demographic overgeneralizations (e.g., assuming all refugees are Middle Eastern and Muslim) and gender disparities in assigned educational levels between mothers and fathers.
